Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is all we have from this game. Afghanistan have taken a 1-0 lead in the series and if they win the next game, then they will seal both the ODI and the T20I series. Zimbabwe will look to stop that from happening. The second T20I is less than 24 hours away, with play to begin at 4.30 pm IST (11 am GMT) on Sunday, the 12th of June. Our build-up will begin much sooner. Till then, take care and goodbye!

Najibullah Zadran (44* off 25 balls) is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his match-winning knock. He says that when he went in to bat, he had a chat with Darwish Rasooli to build a stand and then look to target the final four overs. Adds that he was seeing the ball well and just hit through the line. Zadran then shows a beautiful gesture as he dedicates the award to debutant Nijat Masood and shares it with him.

Mohammad Nabi, the captain of Afghanistan says that they did well with the ball and it was a good start with the bat but applauds Zimbabwe for making a comeback and goes on to applaud Najibullah Zadran for his knock as well. Ends by saying that he is happy and that one over off Blessing Muzarabani sealed the game for them.

Craig Ervine says that he is definitely happy with the effort but is disappointment as it is another loss for them. Adds that they thought 150-160 was par but they would have liked to get some more runs. On being asked about his sensational fielding, he has a laugh about it.
Presentation ceremony...

After opting to bat first, Zimbabwe didn't have the bests of starts but a few small partnerships and a flourish at the death from Sikandar Raza helped them achieve a defendable total. Debutant, Nijat Masood was on song for the visitors with a three-wicket haul. The Afghan openers came out with intent and took the sting out of the chase right inside the Powerplay. Ryan Burl's effort went in vain in the end as the hosts suffered yet another loss and now they will look to focus on the next game.

Zimbabwe will be heartbroken after that loss. Blessing Muzarabani is generally Craig Ervine's most reliable bowler but he had an outing to forget and the decision to give him the last over didn't work out either. After a poor Powerplay, it was Ryan Burl who picked up three wickets in a single over that gave Zimbabwe a lifeline. Quickly, Burl and Sikandar Raza had the visitors in a web of spin and had taken a lead in the game but the pacers traveled today. Blessing Muzarabani gave away 26 runs in his third over that took the game out of Zimbabwe's reach completely.

Chasing 160, Afghanistan got off to a flier as both openers were hitting the ball cleanly, especially Hazratullah Zazai! The pair of Gurbaz and Zazai put on an opening stand of 83 runs before both of them fell in quick succession and then Afghanistan were three down in the same over. Najibullah Zadran and Darwish Rasooli did the repair work and got their side back in the game. It was then the power of Zadran and a few important blows off the skipper's willow that ensured the visitors keep up their winning run.

What a match we have had but in the end, it is Afghanistan who keep their winning run going and extend it to four wins now on the trot. They also take a 1-0 lead in the three-match T20I series. Heartbreak for Zimbabwe though because they made a hell of a comeback in the middle overs but it wasn't meant to be.

SIX! DONE AND DUSTED! Najibullah Zadran has finished off the match in style! Slower delivery, on a length and on leg stump. Zadran just swings at it and clears the vacant backward square leg fence. Afghanistan win by 6 wickets!
Sloppy fielding again and Afghanistan get an extra run. Very full and on leg stump, Najibullah Zadran drills it towards Milton Shumba at long on who fumbles and the batters race back for the second.
Surprise, surprise! Craig Ervine opts to bowl Blessing Muzarabani for the final over and not Luke Jongwe. Could this be the decision that makes the difference? Can Muzarabani defend 7 runs?
A dot to end and Tendai Chatara has just about kept his side in the game. This is on a length but is pushed wider. Nabi backs away to hit but just can't reach it. 8 required off the final over now.
Excellent bowling! Very full and on middle, Najibullah Zadran looks to go big but can't get under it. Zadran gets an inside edge onto the pads as the batters scamper through for one.
Full and straight, driven down the ground to long on for a single.
Top comeback from Tendai Chatara! Nabi tries to step out but Chatara nails the yorker on middle. Nabi just about jams it out.
Edged and four! Short of a length, around off. Nabi backs away and has a swing at it. The ball flies off the top edge and over short third man for a boundary. Just the run-a-ball required now.
FOUR! Length ball, around off. Mohammad Nabi punches it sweetly through extra cover. The fielder puts in the dive to his right at the fence but can't cut it off, boundary.
Tendai Chatara to bowl the penultimate over.
Very full and on off, pushed through mid on for a single. 18 needed now off 12 balls.
FOUR! Placed to perfection! Full and wide, Mohammad Nabi creams it past the diving fielder at the extra cover fence for a boundary.
WIDE! Slower again, spilled down the leg side.
Another slower delivery, bowled into the deck. Najibullah Zadran swings at it and gets it to the right of deep mid-wicket for just a single.
Full and on the pads, clipped away past backward square leg for one.

OUT! BOWLED'EM! Gem of a slower delivery from Luke Jongwe and he has broken the stand. This is just pitched up a bit and it's the off cutter. The ball comes in off the surface as Darwish Rasooli swings hard across the line. Rasooli gets undone by the lack of pace and the ball goes on to crash into the off pole. Could this be the wicket that turns the tide? 26 needed off 16 balls.
Mohammad Nabi is the new man in.
WIDE! A slower ball, bowled into the deck but spilled beyond the tramline outside off. Wide called.
Full and on off stump, this is hammered towards wide long on for just a single. Zadran wanted two but Darwish Rasooli is a bit too slow.
Luke Jongwe is back into the attack.
Full and around off, this is drilled down to long off for one. Najibullah Zadran will keep the strike for the next over and now 28 runs are required off 18 balls.

Would you believe it? The batters have run four! Slower delivery, on a length and on leg stump. Najibullah Zadran just punches it towards wide long on but Wesley Madhevere is just a bit casual and misses the ball completely. He has to run back and cut off the boundary but it doesn't matter. Sloppy from Zimbabwe at a crucial stage.
WIDE! Just not getting it right here Blessing Muzarabani. Full and wide, a bit too wide again though.
WIDE! Attempted wide yorker but spilled beyond the tramline. Wide called.
Length ball, angled into off. Darwish Rasooli hangs back and keeps it out on the off side for a quick single.
Nails the yorker on off stump, Zadran drills it towards long on for one.

NO BALL AND SIX! Oh, my! How the tables keep on turning in this game! Slower one, pitched up and on middle. Najibullah Zadran has just smoked it a long way back over the bowler's head for another monster hit. To add insult to injury, Blessing Muzarabani has overstepped and it will be a Free hit!
SIX! WOW! Blessing Muzarabani bangs it in on a shorter length and over middle. Najibullah Zadran just lays into it and hits it a million miles high and long over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
FOUR! Well struck! hard length and outside off, Najibullah Zadran holds still and muscles it over the wide mid off region for a boundary. 50 needed now off 23 balls.
Blessing Muzarabani is back on.
Leg bye! Quicker one, on the pads. Zadran looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards short fine leg as the batters pick up a leg bye.
FOUR! Finally, a boundary and a much-needed one as well. This is around off, Najibullah Zadran gets low and lofts it powerfully over covers for a boundary.
Around leg, Rasooli tickles it around the corner for a single.
This is dragged down on off stump, Darwish Rasooli can't get it away.
Short and wide, cut away to deep backward point for a single. The 100is up for Afghanistan.
This is full and speared into off, Najibullah Zadran attempts the reverse sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal from the bowler but no one else seems interested.
Around middle and off, Zadran uses his feet to push it down to long off for yet another single. 61 needed now off 30 balls.
Around off, pushed through the cover region for a single.
Brilliant again from the skipper! Around off, hammered to the right of extra cover where Craig Ervine makes yet another superb stop.
Flatter and around off, this is hit through extra cover for just another single. The boundaries have completely dried up for Afghanistan and the pressure keeps on mounting.
Slows it up a bit, on middle and leg. Zadran keeps it out.
Full and on off, driven down to long off for a run.
Length again, outside off this time, Rasooli cuts it behind point for a single.
Back of a length, around off. This is punched towards covers.
A good bumper, around off, around head height. Darwish Rasooli looks to uppercut but misses.
Back of a length, outside off. Darwish Rasooli hops and taps it towards point.
On a good length, around off. Zadran steers it down to third man for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Rasooli half-pulls it down to long on and rotates the strike.
On off, knocked down to long off for a single. 68 needed now off 42 balls.
Brilliant fielding! Tossed up, outside off. Darwish Rasooli hits it hard and towards extra cover but Craig Ervine makes a sharp stop down to his right.
Drifted into the pads, worked away towards mid-wicket.
The call is for two but they will have to settle for one. On leg stump, Zadran drives it through mid on for a run.
Around off, played through cover-point for one more.
Quicker and fuller, on off. This is pushed down to long off for one.
Floated up, outside off. Darwish Rasooli drives but straight to the man at extra cover.
On off, driven through mid off for a single.
The dots keep on coming and a bit of pressure getting built up on the Afghanistan batters. Shorter, around off, tapped towards point.
Flatter this time and outside off, Zadran misses the cut shot.
Nicely drifted into middle and leg, Najibullah Zadran defends it out.
Quicker and on middle, knocked down to long on for a single.
Najibullah Zadran is in at number 5.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Regis Chakabva holds on to the catch and Ryan Burl is turning it on here, three wickets in the over for him. This is on a length, around off and turning away a bit. Usman Ghani makes the mistake of swinging across the line and gets a thick outside edge on it. The keeper, fumbles but gets it on the second attempt. Zimbabwe well and truly back in the game now. 74 needed now off 54 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Regis Chakabva b Ryan Burl

Commentary.Commentary: Floated up around off, Darwish Rasooli pushes it towards extra cover for a single.
Good running! Around off, kept out on the off side and the batters scamper through for one.
Flatter, on middle. This is pushed towards mid on for a single.
Darwish Rasooli is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Two in two for Ryan Burl and Hazratullah Zazai has given away his wicket here! This is tossed up on middle, Zazai dances down the track and looks to muscle it over the long on fence but doesn't quite get to the pitch of the ball. Zazai ends up hitting it straight down the throat of Sikandar Raza who takes a sharp catch. Burl on a hat-trick now.
Commentary.Howout: c Sikandar Raza b Ryan Burl

Commentary.Commentary: Usman Ghani is in at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Finally, a breakthrough for Zimbabwe and could this change the momentum a bit? Ryan Burl just serves it on a length and gives it a bit of flight. Rahmanullah Gurbaz comes down the track and looks to swing across the line. The ball flies high off the top edge and around the point region. The keeper, Regis Chakabva calls it early and settles under it nicely to take the catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Regis Chakabva b Ryan Burl

Commentary.Commentary: Another stifled appeal but sliding down leg. This is speared into the pads and Zazai misses the flick. 77 needed now off 60 balls.
Swing and a miss! Nicely flighted and around off, Hazratullah Zazai swings hard across the line but misses the ball by a mile.
Leg bye! Drifting down leg, Gurbaz looks to sweep but gets it off the pads towards short fine leg for a leg bye.
Shorter in length and around off, this is punched sweetly off the back foot towards deep extra cover for just a single.
Huge appeal from the bowler but not given! Flatter and around leg, Gurbaz looks to sweep but gets an inside edge towards short fine leg. Single taken.
Short and on middle, Rahmanullah Gurbaz pulls it aerially towards deep backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Misfield! Poor from the skipper, Craig Ervine. Around off, just pushed towards extra cover where Ervine takes his eyes off the ball and picks up a single.
Just slows it up a touch does Ryan Burl and floats it around off. Gurbaz taps it towards covers.
This is pushed through quicker and on off. Gurbaz defends it out.
Leg bye! Fuller and down the leg side, Zazai looks to sweep but misses. The ball goes off the pads towards square leg and they get a run.
A bit of a halt in play as Hazratullah Zazai seems to be struggling with cramps. The physio is out and is having a look. Hope he is fine.
This is dragged down a bit on leg, Gurbaz goes deep in his crease and works it leg side for a single.
On a length and on leg stump, Zazai nudges it past square leg for a single.
Shorter and outside off, Hazratullah Zazai cuts it off the back foot past point and picks up a single. Tidy start from Raza, just the 4 singles off it.
On leg, nudged away through mid-wicket for one more.
Quicker this time from Raza and on off, Zazai pushes it down to long off and rotates the strike.
Flatter and outside off, Zazai taps it towards point.
Around middle, Gurbaz steps down the track and powers it straight back past the bowler. The fielder at long on does well to cut it off. Just the single then.
Starts off with a nicely flighted delivery around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! It is difficult to keep him quiet at the moment. It is short and on off. Zazai pulls it powerfully through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Sikandar Raza to roll his arm now.
Wide! This one is sprayed down leg. Zazai fails to work it away. Wided.
Flatter and short, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz losses his control this time as he looks to cut it away. The ball goes through the keeper off the inside edge. They take one.
FOUR! Gurbaz joins the party now. It is short and outside off. Gurbaz cuts it hard through point on his back foot. Wesley Madhevere puts in a dive in the deep but in vain.
Short and on off. Gurbaz defends it to cover.
On middle and leg. Gurbaz flicks it to mid-wicket for two runs. This is really good cricket by Afghanistan.
Flighted and full, on off. Zazai hits it down to long on for one.
Ainsley Ndlovu is brought into the attack now.
Full length, on off. Zazai works it to square leg off the inside edge. The batters cross for a single. 15 runs off the over, Afghanistan on top.
FOUR! Three on the trot! Zazai showing no mercy here. It is short and on off. Zazai stands tall and slaps it past the bowler for a fine boundary.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Zazai! It is full and outside off. Zazai stands back and creams it through the cover region for four more.
FOUR! Top shot! It is full and wide outside off. Zazai reaches out and crunches it down to long on for a boundary.
WIDE! This is full and wide, outside the tramline. Zazai lets it be. Wide called.
On a length, around off. Gurbaz dabs it to the right of short third man. Blessing Muzarabani dives to that side and makes a great stop to only allow a single.
A slower ball, on a good length, this one lands on off and nips in off the deck. Rahmanullah Gurbaz makes room but is unable to send it away. The ball scoots past the leg pole.
Blessing Muzarabani goes for 12 in his second over. A length ball, on the pads. Gurbaz stays back and flicks it to square leg for one.
Short ball, outside off. Zazai punches it towards deep backward point for one.
FOUR! Up and over! A slower one, wide outside off. Zazai reaches out and hits it enough to clear the man at mid off and gets a boundary.
Another single now, as Gurbaz dabs this length delivery down to third man.
Muzarabani hits the length hard this time. Zazai defends it to the leg side for a quick single.
FOUR! Hazratullah Zazai seems to be in stormy mood. It is a slower ball, short and on off. Zazai picks up the length early and pulls it through the gap at mid-wicket for a cracking boundary.
Blessing Muzarabani (1-0-9-0) to bowl from the opposite end now.
This is touch shorter, on top of off. Gurbaz plays it late and works it towards backward point.
FOUR! Shot of authourity! It is full, on off. Gurbaz gets behind it and slaps it over covers for a boundary.
BYE! Length, angled across the left-hander, outside off. Zazai slashes but misses. The keeper fails to collect it and the batters sneak a bye.
FOUR! A shot and a half, this! It is fuller, on off. Luke Jongwe bowls a slower one but that does not bother Zazai at all, as he powers it down the ground for a boundary.
In the air...but safe! It is overpitched, on off. Gurbaz miscues his loft towards long on which keeps him at the crease as the ball lands safely. The batters take a single.
Full length, on off. Gurbaz pushes it to cover on the front foot.
Luke Jongwe to have a bowl now.
Back of a length, on middle. Gurbaz stays back and pulls it through the gap at square leg for one more. A good over by Chatara comes to an end.
Short and on off. Zazai pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Zazai taps this length delivery towards covers.
Length ball, on the pads, Gurbaz tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
Good length, outside off. Gurbaz tries to chase it but misses.
Short ball, wide outside off. Gurbaz cuts it hard but only to backward point.
A single now as this is worked to mid off.
A slower length ball, around off. Gurbaz works it down to third man for a brace.
Touch short, around the hips. Zazai clips it to mid-wicket and scampers across for a single. Craig Ervine misfields but Rahmanullah Gurbaz wisely sends his partner back.
Length ball, outside off. gurbaz taps it to the off side for a quick single.
FOUR! Rahmanullah Gurbaz gets his first boundary of the chase. It is a short ball, in the channel. Rahmanullah Gurbaz stays back and slams it over backward point for a boundary.
Length and on off. Gurbaz taps it to point.
Blessing Muzarabani to start from the opposite end.

FOUR! Width on offer and punished! It is a short ball, wide outside off. Zazai hangs back and cuts it through point for a boundary. 8 runs off the first over and Afghanistan are off to a flying start.
Touch fuller, on middle. Gurbaz comes down the track and lofts it towards long on. He does not connect well, which is good for him as there is a man stationed in the deep. A single taken.
Tendai Chatara gets this to get into the right-hander. Gurbaz stays back and tucks it to mid-wicket.
A length ball, around off. Gurbaz fends it to the off side.
Swing and a miss! It is a length ball, outside off. Gurbaz uses his feet and tries to smack it down the ground but only manages to connect with thin air.
Afghanistan and Hazratullah Zazai are off the mark. It is a length ball, outside off. Zazai stays back and punches it through the gap at covers for three runs.
